record.question: During history collection, a 30 year old female patient complaint to the nurse that she passes small amount of urine while she coughs or sneezes. Nurse identified this as:
record.explanation: Answer D: Stress incontinence. Stress urinary incontinence is leakage with increased abdominal pressure such as coughing or sneezing. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/urologic-diseases/stress-urinary-incontinence. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
